overview: The Resonance Core is the epicenter of Luclin’s harmonic anomalies.
details: Crystal‑void structures amplify sonic energy into destructive pulses. The Mutated Sonic Horror dwells here, feeding on resonance instability.
hooks: A harmonic spike threatens to collapse nearby caverns.
Crystal growth accelerates unnaturally, forming new chambers.
Shadow Haven miners detect resonance pulses reaching the surface.
The Mutated Sonic Horror splits into echo‑clones during combat.
